senses.gloss:
चुर् चुर्. i. 10, चोरय, † i. 1, [] Par.
 1. To steal, Man. 8, 333.
 2. To steal from, Hariv. 11146.
 --Cf. चोर.
† चूर् चूर्, i. 4, Ātm. To burn.

चूर्ण् चूर्ण्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par.
 1. To grind, Suśr. 2, 56, 3.
 2. To crush, MBh. 3, 12133.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To powder, to cover with a ground substance, Suśr. 1, 46, 14; MBh. 8, 456.
 2. To cover, MBh. 2, 813.
 --With विनि वि-नि, To crush, MBh. 8, 4665.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To grind, MBh. 1, 4773.
 2. To crush, Rām. 6, 87, 23.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To grind, Suśr. 1, 162, 19.
 2. To crush, MBh. 7, 1394; Rājat. 5, 411.

चूर्ण चूर्ण (an old ptcple. pf. pass. akin to चर्व्), m. and n. Any pulverulent or minute division of substance.
 1. Flour, Pañc. 121, 11.
 2. Dust, MBh. 3, 10972.
 3. Powder, MBh. 6, 5764.
 4. Aromatic powder, Megh. 69.
 --Comp.
चूर्णक चूर्ण + क, n. Aromatic powder, Suśr. 2, 392, 11.
चूर्णता चूर्ण + ता, f. State of powder, Rājat. 5, 16.
चूर्णशस् चूर्ण + शस्, adv. Into powder, MBh. 1, 3225.
चूर्णिका चूर्णिका, i. e. चूर्ण + क, f. A sort of pastry, Lass. 11, 20.
चूर्ण- + योग चूर्ण- + योग, m. a mixture of fragrant powders, MBh. 12, 2163.
